summary.motive: Punish Cover 2 flat defenders who sit on the short routes created by the vertical passing game.
summary.whyItWorks: The snap move steals the corner's leverage and the pump freeze delays the flat defender exactly long enough for the wall to form in front of the catch.
summary.failureMode: The flat trigger fires immediately on the guard release and meets the receiver at the catch point before any wall can form.

beats.title: 1. The Snap Move
beats.text: The flanker takes a hard two-step inside move that snaps the corner's eyes and leverage down into the route, while the line sells a full pass-protection look.

beats.title: 2. The Constraint Releases
beats.text: With the corner leaning inside, Z snaps back outside for width and the near guards release to build the screen wall. The defense still reads pure dropback.

beats.title: 3. The Freeze Pump
beats.text: The quarterback pumps vertically, freezing the Mike and the deep-half safeties for one critical beat while the wall blockers get their heads on pursuers.

beats.title: 4. The Screen Catch and Turn
beats.text: The screen arrives with Z already facing upfield behind three escorts. The flat defender is stalk-blocked and the corner is recovering from the wrong lever.

relations.tell: Z's alignment move happens before the ball is out of the quarterback's hand — a true vertical shot has no pre-break stem move.
